escalations.summary: The separate v1.0 validation implementation is committed and merged into the isolated Wave 1 candidate; final direct-main integration waits only for its lead-owned JIT gate state to be committed.
The invoker authorized a targeted retry and reset the counter with explicit guidance that profile apply dry-run is part of the repeatable ordered-selector contract.

Session 2 handed off after the release smoke workflow exposed one stale dry-run consumer. A final authorized Luna xhigh repair updated that workflow and its acceptance test; all configured gates passed, and the exact merged main tree passed cargo-ci plus the MCP suite.

After two substantive rework rounds produced a fully tested final commit, the lead Tier 2.5 sweep found one remaining stale neighbouring phrase at docs/reference/storage-format.md:67 ('minimal provenance record'). The invoker selected option 1 and authorized one narrowly targeted Luna xhigh retry.

After two rework rounds, exact cargo-ci passed at abea9028 but code-review found that the first successful apply of two equal contributors records shared ownership only in the later package record; the first record converges only on a second apply. The invoker selected option 1 and authorized one targeted Terra xhigh retry spanning command, initialization, and provenance boundaries without pulling Wave 7's transaction redesign forward.

review_verdicts.notes: Round 1 code-review FAIL was a lead-caused scope error: the dispatch forbade documenting the commands in cli-commands.md, leaving them with no canonical home (@/charter/D-13). Lead wrote the reference entries; gate re-run passed.

Five code-review rounds. R1 docs home (lead scope error). R2 aggregate target list cloned per entry. R3 repeat occurrence listed targets it does not publish. R4 schema prose stated apply's entry-set rule for all three commands. Root cause across R2-R4: changing the rehearsal entry-set shape invalidates every statement describing it, and findings were supplied one at a time. Closed by a worker-authored field-by-occurrence-shape matrix and a SelectionObservation trait that states 'publishes nothing' once per answer type.

surfaced_pitfalls.subject: v1.0 applied-record migration boundary
surfaced_pitfalls.detail: is_shipped_v1_candidate authenticates only the pinned embedded jit-dogfood record; a real v1.0 repository (gf2, two directory-package records) is rejected outright by jit validate. Bears on epic REQ-09 and REQ-12.

surfaced_pitfalls.subject: shipped_v1_conversion_count test race
surfaced_pitfalls.detail: commands::init::tests::test_profiled_init_authenticates_shipped_v1_once_before_any_publication asserts on a process-global counter; fails under `cargo test -p jit --lib profile`, passes unfiltered and with --test-threads=1. Pre-existing, needs its own issue.

surfaced_pitfalls.subject: fail-fast conflict reporting
surfaced_pitfalls.detail: The three-way seam reports the first conflicting target only. REQ-03 says 'reports a conflict' so 7156f64b passes literally; reporting all would change apply's error type (shared seam).

surfaced_pitfalls.subject: profiles.md stale deferral
surfaced_pitfalls.detail: 'semantic shared ownership' still listed as deferred though wave 6 landed it. Covered by b3d92595 REQ-01.

surfaced_pitfalls.subject: ProfileTargetMaterialization carries no owner
surfaced_pitfalls.detail: A rehearsal repeats the same aggregate target list once per selector. Fix at source belongs to cb26de35. Closed: owner field added and rehearsal entries scoped per profile (47813ac7, ac1a5cf8). Recorded here as a lead triage error — it was filed as future work and the reviewer correctly bound it to REQ-04 of this issue.

surfaced_pitfalls.subject: apply --dry-run rehearsal/run asymmetry
surfaced_pitfalls.detail: jit profile apply --dry-run plans each selector's package alone, so its rehearsal reports one entry per selector while its run reports closure members plus root occurrences. Same class as the REQ-04 findings on reconfigure/upgrade but on a command this issue does not own. Closing it means switching apply onto plan_resolved_profile_selection (one aggregate preview instead of N per-package previews) plus re-merging the two doc statements at cli-commands.md:703 and profiles.md:117.

surfaced_pitfalls.subject: lead triage: findings supplied one at a time
surfaced_pitfalls.detail: Rounds 2 and 3 of code-review were the same defect class (rehearsal entry fidelity). The lead passed on each finding individually instead of the whole entry contract; the reviewer has no cross-round memory, so completeness must come from the lead. Round 4 requires a full field-by-occurrence-shape matrix as the deliverable.
